No Fences | No Fences is the second studio album by the American country music artist Garth Brooks.  It was released on August 27, 1990, and reached #1 on "Billboard's" Top Country Albums chart. Thicker Than Blood (song) | "Thicker Than Blood" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music artist Garth Brooks.  It was released in May 2002 as the fourth single from the album "Scarecrow".  The song reached number 18 on the "Billboard" Hot Country Singles & Tracks chart.  It was written by Brooks and Jenny Yates.
That Summer (song) | "That Summer" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music artist Garth Brooks.  It was released in April 1993 as the fourth single from his album "The Chase" and also appears on "The Hits", "The Ultimate Hits", "The Limited Series" and "Double Live".  It reached number-one on the Billboard Country Charts in 1993.  The song was written by Garth Brooks, Pat Alger and Brooks' then-wife Sandy Mahl.
